topic: A person learns their favorite restaurant is closing
text: I can hardly believe it when I step into the familiar warmth of my favorite restaurant and the manager breaks the news. For years, this place has been more than just a spot to grab a meal; it's been a sanctuary, a place where the waitstaff remembers my name and my order before I even open my mouth. The walls, adorned with the same cozy paintings for what feels like forever, seem to close in a little as the words sink in. How will I fill the void left by the scent of freshly baked bread and the gentle hum of happy diners? I cling to the edge of my seat, trying to make sense of a world without this comfort.
